about.moneyP1: We believe in transparency, so here's how we fund OAM:
about.moneyP2: On bill payments, we earn a <1>small margin</1> (typically ₦10–₦20 on a ₦1,000 purchase) built into the price you see. No hidden fees.
about.moneyP3: On the Marketplace and Home Services, we earn from <1>optional paid plans</1>—sellers and artisans can subscribe for more visibility and features. Listing and messaging are free.
about.moneyP4: On travel bookings, we earn a <1>referral commission</1> from our partners at no extra cost to you.
about.safetyP1: Phone numbers on the Marketplace and Home Services are <1>never published</1>. They're exchanged only after you accept an enquiry, so your number stays private.
about.safetyP2: Payments are processed by <1>Paystack</1> and Flutterwave. Card details are entered on their secure pages and are never seen or stored by OAM.
about.noteBody: <1>Note:</1> OAM is newly launched, so some sections—especially the Marketplace and Artisans directory—are still growing. Coverage expands as more people join.

electricity.title: Electricity tokens
electricity.q1: I paid for units but no token appeared. What now?
electricity.a1p1: <1>Don't buy again.</1> Your payment has gone through and the order is with your provider — buying a second time charges you twice for the same meter.
electricity.a1p2: Open <1>Order history</1>. While an order is still completing you'll see "Token on the way", and the page checks with your provider every few seconds. Tokens usually arrive within a minute or two, occasionally longer at busy times.
electricity.a1p3: The token is also emailed to you as soon as it's issued, so you'll get it even if you've closed the app.
electricity.q2: Where can I find an old token?
electricity.a2: Every token is stored permanently in <1>Order history</1> — open the order and it's there with a copy button. It's also in the receipt email we sent at the time.
electricity.a3: Nigerian prepaid meters are <1>11 digits</1>. We only check with your disco once all 11 are entered, so a message while you're still typing just means we're waiting. If a complete number is still rejected, check you've picked the right disco — a valid meter on the wrong disco will always fail.

wallet.title: Wallet and payments
wallet.q1: Why does my card payment go into my wallet first?
wallet.a1p1: Card payments credit your wallet, and the wallet then pays for what you bought. It looks like an extra step, and it's deliberate.
wallet.a1p2: If a delivery fails, the money is already sitting safely in your wallet as a balance you can spend or withdraw. Paying a provider directly would leave your money stranded between the card processor and them, with no clean way back.
wallet.a2: No. The total shown before you pay is what you pay — the fee line reads ₦0 because there isn't one. Our margin is built into the price of bills, so nothing is added at checkout.
wallet.a3: Bank transfers usually land within minutes, though they can take longer during bank downtime. If a withdrawal fails, the amount is returned to your wallet automatically — it isn't lost, and you can try again.
wallet.q4: Can I send money to another OAM user?
wallet.a4: Yes — <1>Transfer</1> moves money between OAM wallets instantly and free. Enter their email or phone number and their name appears before you confirm. <2>Check that name carefully</2>: completed transfers can't be reversed.

marketplace.title: Marketplace and artisans
marketplace.q1: Why can't I see a seller's phone number?
marketplace.a1p1: Numbers are never published. Send a message about the item, and once the seller accepts, you'll both see each other's contact details.
marketplace.a1p2: It's slightly slower, and it's the single most effective protection we can offer: published numbers get scraped, and scraped numbers get used for impersonation scams.
marketplace.q2: How many things can I list for free?
marketplace.a2: Three active listings, indefinitely, with no card required. Premium (₦2,500) adds up to 20 listings plus featured placement, and Pro (₦5,000) is unlimited.
marketplace.q3: How do I stay safe buying and selling?
marketplace.a3li1: Meet in a public place during daylight
marketplace.a3li2: Inspect the item before any money changes hands
marketplace.a3li3: Never send money in advance to someone you haven't met
marketplace.a3li4: Keep the conversation in OAM, so there's a record of what was agreed
marketplace.a3li5: Treat any request to move to WhatsApp "for a better price" as a warning sign
marketplace.q4: What does boosting an artisan profile do?
marketplace.a4: It places your profile above unboosted ones in search results, where most people look. Premium is ₦2,500 for 30 days and Pro is ₦5,000 for 90. Both are <1>one-off payments</1> — nothing renews automatically.

account.title: Account
account.q1: Can I use the same account to buy and to sell?
account.a1: Yes. One account does everything — you might sell a fridge and hire a plumber in the same week. Your messages are split into "My enquiries" and "Enquiries to me" so the two don't get tangled.
account.q2: Is my card stored on OAM?
account.a2: No. Card details are entered on Paystack's secure checkout and are never seen or stored by us.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how OAM collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
privacy.controlBody: O.A.M Motors Limited is the data controller for your personal information. For any privacy-related inquiries, email us at <1>info@oam-app.com</1>.
privacy.giveLi1: Name, email address, phone number, and other registration details.
privacy.giveLi2: Payment information (card details are processed by our payment partners and never stored by us).
privacy.giveLi4: Communications with us and with other users through our platform.
privacy.createdLi1: Device information, IP address, and usage logs.
privacy.createdLi2: Location data (if you permit) to show nearby services.
privacy.collectCard: We do not store your card details. All card payments are handled by our PCI-DSS compliant payment processors.
privacy.whyLi1: To provide and improve our services, process transactions, and communicate with you.
privacy.whyLi2: To prevent fraud, enforce our Terms, and comply with legal obligations.
privacy.whyNoSell: We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.whoIntro: We share data only with trusted partners who need it to perform their services:
privacy.whoLi1: Payment processors (e.g., Paystack, Flutterwave) for transaction handling.
privacy.whoLi2: Service providers (e.g., SMS, email, cloud hosting) that help us operate.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: These Terms and Conditions govern your use of the OAM platform and services.
terms.s1Body: By creating an account or using OAM, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.
terms.s2P1: You must be at least 18 years old to open an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your password and any activities that occur under your account.
terms.s2P2: You agree to provide accurate and complete information when registering and to keep that information updated.
terms.s3P1: Your OAM wallet holds funds that you can use for purchases and transfers. Funds are not insured and do not earn interest.
terms.s3P2: You can fund your wallet via card, bank transfer, or other supported methods. Withdrawals are subject to verification and applicable limits.
terms.s3P3: All transactions are final once completed. Please double-check recipient details before confirming.
terms.s4P1: OAM may charge fees for certain services, which will be clearly disclosed before you complete a transaction.
terms.s4P2: Transaction limits may apply based on your account verification level. Higher limits are available for verified accounts.
terms.s5P1: You may not use OAM for any illegal or fraudulent purpose. This includes money laundering, fraud, or any activity that violates Nigerian law.
terms.s5P2: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account if we suspect misuse.
terms.s6P1: All content and trademarks on OAM are owned by us or our licensors. You may not copy, modify, or distribute any content without our permission.
terms.s7P1: OAM is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free service.
terms.s8P1: To the fullest extent permitted by law, OAM shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform.
terms.s9P1: You agree to indemnify and hold OAM harmless from any claims arising from your violation of these Terms.
terms.s10P1: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. Disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Lagos, Nigeria.
terms.s11P1: We may update these Terms from time to time. We will notify you of material changes via email or in-app notification.
terms.s12P1: If you have any questions about these Terms, please contact us at <1>info@oam-app.com</1>.

refund.title: Refund and Cancellation Policy
refund.intro: This policy explains the terms for refunds, cancellations, and dispute resolution on OAM.
refund.s1P1: We strive to ensure every transaction is completed successfully. However, sometimes things don't go as planned. This policy sets out your rights and our obligations.
refund.s2P1: If a transaction fails after your wallet has been debited, the amount will be automatically refunded to your wallet within 24 hours. If it doesn't, please contact support.
refund.s2P2: For card payments that fail after the card is charged, the funds will be reversed to your card within 3-5 business days, subject to your bank's processing time.
refund.s3P1: If a service you paid for (e.g., airtime, data, electricity token) is not delivered within a reasonable time, we will investigate and either complete the delivery or issue a full refund.
refund.s3P2: Please do not attempt to purchase the same service again while an order is pending. Duplicate purchases may not be refundable if both succeed.
refund.s4P1: You may cancel a pending order before it is processed. Once processing begins, cancellation may not be possible.
refund.s4P2: For travel bookings (flights, hotels, etc.), cancellations are subject to the partner's policy. Please check the partner's terms before booking.
refund.s5P1: If you have a dispute regarding a transaction, please contact us within 30 days of the transaction date. We will investigate and respond within 5 business days.
refund.s5P2: If we cannot resolve the dispute, you may escalate to your card issuer or bank.
refund.s6P1: If you believe a transaction is fraudulent or unauthorized, please contact us immediately. We will work with you and our payment partners to resolve the issue.
refund.s7P1: For any refund or cancellation requests, please email us at <1>info@oam-app.com</1> with your order reference and details.
refund.s8P1: We may update this policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page.
